item.title: New Roads’ historic CCC parade keeps century-old Mardi Gras tradition rolling
item.description: New Roads, Louisiana has been hosting the Community Center Carnival parade, the oldest parade in the state outside of New Orleans, since 1922, drawing crowds of up to 100,000 people.
